info.name: Retrieve a previous AI diagram request

params.name: requestId
params.description: ID of the AI request to retrieve (from /api/render/prompt response)

params.name: returnFile
params.description: When true, returns the PNG image file directly instead of JSON

items.docs: Retrieves the inputs and outputs of a previously generated AI diagram request by its request ID. Optionally returns the PNG image directly as a file stream.
